Stock market India | India's 10 most valuable listed companies

The 10 largest companies listed on NSE by market value, as of the close on 24 November 2026.

1. Reliance: ₹18.28 lakh crore
2. Airtel: ₹13.28 lakh crore
3. HDFC Bank: ₹12.62 lakh crore
4. ICICI Bank: ₹11.39 lakh crore
5. SBI: ₹10.46 lakh crore
6. TCS: ₹8.90 lakh crore
7. Bajaj Finance: ₹6.95 lakh crore
8. L&T: ₹5.64 lakh crore
9. Kotak Bank: ₹5.00 lakh crore
10. HUL: ₹4.74 lakh crore

Together they are worth ₹97.27 lakh crore.
